quote: Recent advances in techniques for generating realistic synthetic content (i.e., deepfakes) pose a diverse set of problems with significant societal consequences. The advent of large language models for text generation have made it easier than ever to create convincing synthetic text.
outputs: The paper focuses on detecting machine-generated technical text, particularly generated or tampered scientific abstracts and full-length research papers. The generated outputs are synthetic paragraphs and abstracts created using GPT-2 domain-tuned on technical text, and the detection outputs are binary classifications (real vs. generated) and document-level tampering scores.
